main_text.p: cem, quousque illa cum suis singularum principiis posset confistere, quamvis non in omnibus juxta eafdem ordinis Ecclesiastici incedant regulas.

XXX. Ecclesiæ juxta Christi mentem collectæ & ambulantes, quas judicant alias (licet minus puras) Ecclesias esse veras, possunt in communionem secum occasionaliter recipere istarum Ecclesiarum membra, quæ verisimile habent testimonium pietatis, & vitam degunt absque scandalo.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: The faint text below the word FINIS is show-through from the reverse page and is not transcribed. Words in the first paragraph are read from a slightly blurred scan; "posset" and "occasionaliter" are doubtful where the print is faint ("possunt" and "occasionalem" as printed in the scan: "occasionalem"). Printed text reads "collectæ" with a long-s style ligature in "collestæ"; treated as collectæ.
